highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148 with variable fonts and animated WebP.
highlights_body: The engine jumps from milestone 132 through 148, bringing variable font support end-to-end (SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp), color font palettes, animated WebP encoding, and a reworked singleton lifecycle. This is a breaking release for anyone relying on legacy typeface-resolution nulls or a Vulkan 1.0 device — read the breaking changes below before upgrading.

breaking.title: new SKFont() now has an empty typeface, not a lazy default
breaking.body: Upstream removed the lazy "resolve default at draw time" behavior, so an unset SKFont.Typeface is now SKTypeface.Empty (0 glyphs) instead of resolving to the platform default — MeasureText now returns 0. Construct with an explicit typeface (e.g. new SKFont(SKTypeface.Default)) and check Typeface.IsEmpty instead of comparing to null.

breaking.title: new SKPaint().Typeface now returns SKTypeface.Default instead of null
breaking.body: SkiaSharp still seeds a usable default font so text keeps working, but code that checked paint.Typeface == null to detect "no typeface set" no longer fires. Use paint.Typeface.IsEmpty, or drop the check.

breaking.title: SKTypeface.FromFamilyName("missing") no longer returns null on Android
breaking.body: All platforms now consistently fall back to SKTypeface.Default for an unmatched family name, so FromFamilyName is never null. For a strict "was it actually found?" check, use SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily(name), which still returns null on no match.

breaking.title: SKTypeface.Default is now guaranteed non-null
breaking.body: Default resolution moved to the font manager; behavior is unchanged on macOS/Windows/Linux, and Android API 36+ (previously able to return null) now falls back to SKTypeface.Empty instead of crashing.

breaking.title: SKStream.Move(long) now throws on overflow and is obsolete
breaking.body: The native offset is a 32-bit int, so out-of-range offsets used to silently truncate. They now throw OverflowException, and the overload is obsolete (CS0618). Call Move(int) with an in-range, pre-validated offset instead.

breaking.title: GRContext.CreateVulkan aborts the process on Vulkan 1.0 instead of returning null
breaking.body: Ganesh now requires Vulkan 1.1; on a 1.0 instance/device it calls SK_ABORT and terminates the process rather than returning null, and managed code cannot catch it. Declare VK_API_VERSION_1_1 on both the VkApplicationInfo used to create the instance and on GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion (do not leave it at its default 0). Genuinely 1.0-only hardware can no longer use Ganesh Vulkan and must fall back to raster or another backend.

breaking.title: Vulkan GRVkBackendContextNative loses five interop fields
breaking.body: fMinAPIVersion, fInstanceVersion, fExtensions, fFeatures, and fOwnsInstanceAndDevice are removed. Delete those assignments; use fVkExtensions in place of fExtensions and fDeviceFeatures/fDeviceFeatures2 in place of fFeatures. There is no replacement for fOwnsInstanceAndDevice — Skia no longer manages instance/device ownership through the backend context.

breaking.title: GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo renamed to GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo and loses value-equality
breaking.body: The Vulkan Ycbcr conversion info struct now follows the SkiaSharp GR casing convention and gains a new Components field. The old name, its IEquatable<T> implementation, and its ==/!= operators are gone — update references and rebuild.

bullets.detail: The bundled engine advances through m132, m133, m147 and lands on m148, folding in the upstream chrome/m147 bug fixes merged along the way — the biggest engine jump in a single SkiaSharp release.

bullets.lead: Variable fonts and color font palettes
bullets.detail: Variable font support is wired through SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp end to end, and SKFont/SKTypeface gain color font palette selection and hardened variable-font handling.

Default typeface lookup moves to the managed layer (fixing #3693) so consumers can observe or override the fallback without a native round-trip, and the legacy font manager entry point sk_fontmgr_legacy_create_typeface is restored for downstream code that depends on it.
SKSurface.Draw and SKCanvas.DrawSurface gain overloads that accept SKSamplingOptions, so callers can pick the mipmap and filter mode instead of an implicit default.

bullets.lead: Zero-copy stream conversion and animated WebP encoding
bullets.detail: SKStream.GetData() turns any seekable stream into an SKData without an intermediate byte[] copy, and SKWebpEncoder can now emit animated WebP files from a frame sequence.

bullets.lead: HBColor struct and missing HarfBuzz wrappers
bullets.detail: HarfBuzzSharp gets a proper HBColor struct matching hb_color_t, plus previously missing or mis-named API wrappers filled in as part of a naming-convention pass.

bullets.lead: SKGLView rendering after MAUI tab switches
bullets.detail: Fixes SKGLView failing to render again after switching away from and back to a MAUI TabBar tab on Android.

bullets.lead: SKPath finalizer and pixel-span offset fixes
bullets.detail: Fixes a finalizer crash when SKPathBuilder is collected before its SKPath, corrects SKPixmap.GetPixelSpan<T>(x,y) to use Height instead of Width for its offset, and further fixes SKPixmap/SKBitmap GetPixelSpan to use RowBytes for stride.
Fixes a missing WinUI Projection DLL that broke .NET 9 consumers referencing SkiaSharp.Views.WinUI.

Reworks how SkiaSharp's singleton instances are created and torn down (fixing #3817), and moves the native-compatibility gate from a [ModuleInitializer] into the SkiaApi static constructor for more predictable initialization order.

bullets.lead: Legacy text/font APIs promoted to compile errors
bullets.detail: The SKPaint text/font members obsoleted in v3, and the remaining legacy paint state-reading APIs, are now compile errors instead of warnings — move typeface and text size onto SKFont if you haven't already.

bullets.lead: Linux Bionic and Tizen x64/arm64 native assets
bullets.detail: Adds Linux Bionic as a supported native asset target and adds Tizen x64/arm64 native build support.
Fixes Apple platform target framework monikers: 26.0 for libraries, unversioned for applications.
Updates libexpat to 2.7.5, libpng to 1.6.58, zlib to 1.3.2.1-motley, freetype to 2.14.3, libjpeg-turbo to 3.1.4.1, expat to 2.8.1, and harfbuzz to 14.2.0.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: The singleton lifecycle rework, the SKPath finalizer fix, variable font and color font palette support, and the managed default-typeface resolution.
contributor_summaries.4Darmygeometry: Linux Bionic native asset support and the PolySharp-based C# 13 support for legacy TFMs.
contributor_summaries.ebariche: Fixed the Skottie package downgrade issue (NU1605) in the Uno gallery sample.
contributor_summaries.sasakrsmanovic: Updated the harfbuzz native dependency to 14.2.0.
contributor_summaries.SimonvBez: Fixed SKGLView not rendering after a MAUI TabBar tab switch.

preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.1.1: Opened the v4 line by bumping Skia to milestone 132/133 and adding PolySharp-based C# 13 support for legacy TFMs.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.2.1: Advanced Skia to milestone 147 and added variable font support across SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.3.1: Added color font palette support, animated WebP encoding, SKStream.GetData(), and the singleton lifecycle rework.
preview_summaries.v4.148.0-rc.1.2: Cut the release candidate with the final m147 sync, the SKPixmap/SKBitmap pixel-span stride fixes, native dependency refreshes, and promoted the remaining legacy obsoletes to compile errors.

harfbuzz_summary: Adds variable-font shaping and an HBColor value type, drops native builds for pre-.NET 8 Emscripten versions, and refreshes the bundled HarfBuzz to 14.2.0.
